text:
alex: Quick sync — proposing a per-org softcap + per-key hard-throttle enforcement model for production. Goal: allow short bursts for healthy apps but stop noisy keys that would harm others. Thoughts?

maria: TL;DR of behavior during overload? softcap = advisory, hard = reject? :thinking_face:

alex: Exactly. Softcap = probabilistic shedding / delayed responses (429 with Retry-After hints or 202-with-delay) when org is over target. Hard-throttle = immediate 429 for offending API key. Precedence: key-level hard throttle > org softcap.

josh: Concern: soft shedding can increase tail latency if we do naive sleeps. Suggest token-bucket + leaky warm-up and an async-prefetch path for streaming requests to avoid blocking main loop.

priya: We also need observability: count of shed requests, per-org peak burst, top offending API keys, and per-plan usage histogram. Dashboard + alerting thresholds are required before rollout.

alex: Agreed. Rough config sketch (proto):
```yaml
policies:
  - name: org-softcap
    scope: org
    threshold_rps: 10  # soft target, platform will start graceful shedding above this
    mode: probabilistic
  - name: key-hard-throttle
    scope: api_key
    limit_rps: 50     # absolute reject above this
    action: reject
```

ops-bot: staging-enforcer deployed to staging at 1765881360 — no regressions in staging tests :white_check_mark:

maria: For Free/Pro/Enterprise mapping we should make defaults conservative and allow overrides for enterprise. My suggestion: Free org-softcap=1 RPS (burst 5), Pro org-softcap=10 RPS (burst 50), Enterprise = customer-configurable. Also include explicit headers on responses: X-Quota-Remaining, X-Quota-Reset, X-Softcap-State.

josh: How do we reflect cost impact? We need clear mapping UI: show projected monthly cost when switching plan or increasing limits (so customers can self-serve). Also consider metered billing for sustained above-softcap usage.

alex: Proposal for plan->quota mapping (draft): Free = softcap 60 RPM, hard per-key 120 RPM; Pro = softcap 600 RPM, hard per-key 1200 RPM; Enterprise = SLA+custom. We'll put mapping in console and default policy rules in infra.

priya: I'll own dashboards: add metric names -> inference.requests.shed, inference.requests.rejected, enforcement.latency.p50/p95, enforcement.per_key_top10. Will add alerts: >0.5% shed over 10m -> page on-call.

maria: We also need rollout UX: start with shadow-enforcement -> opt-in beta -> gradual ramp to enforced with canary on 5% of traffic. Also ensure canaries respect per-key hard limits.

alex: Plan: 1) PR with enforcement hooks + config (I'll open PR #345), 2) priya adds dashboards + alerts, 3) deploy to staging shadow mode, run synthetic attack tests, 4) canary 5% -> monitor -> full enforcement. Owners: alex (design/PR), priya (observability), josh (runtime validation), maria (product sign-off).

josh: +1. Add test-case: one noisy key + lots of small keys to validate org-level softcap behavior.

priya: Will add those to the eval harness and include Grafana dashboard links in PR.

alex: Cool — I'll open PR and tag owners. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
